title: Quick to spend, distressed in shortage
odia:
ଥିଲା ହାତ ଖଲ ଖଲ
ନଥିଲା ହାତ କଲବଲ
literal_meaning: The hand with money is restless to spend; the hand without is distressed.
meaning_odia: ହାତରେ ଟଙ୍କା ଥିଲେ ଅଯଥା ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ମନ ଚଞ୍ଚଳ ହୁଏ; ଟଙ୍କା ସରିଗଲେ ଅଭାବରେ କଲବଲ ହେବାକୁ ପଡ଼େ। ଖଲ ଖଲ ଏଠାରେ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରିବାର ଅସ୍ଥିରତା, କଲବଲ କଷ୍ଟ ପାଇବାକୁ ବୁଝାଏ। ଅନାବଶ୍ୟକ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ନକରି ସଞ୍ଚୟ କରିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ସାବଧାନ କରେ।
explanation: When money is available, the hand is eager to spend it, even unnecessarily. Once it is gone, shortage brings distress. The contrast warns against wasteful spending without saving for later needs.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A workshop spends freely on nonessential purchases after a large payment arrives, then struggles to buy materials. Someone recalls the restless spending hand and the distressed empty one.
cultural_context: The near-rhyme ଖଲ ଖଲ / କଲବଲ makes the change in condition audible. The hand provides a concrete place to imagine what one has available and what one can do with it.

witnesses.locator: Page23, fourth item beginning ଥିଲା ହାତ.

odia_summary: ଥିଲେ ଅଯଥା ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ, ସରିଗଲେ କଷ୍ଟ—ସଞ୍ଚୟ ନକରିବାର ପରିଣାମ।
english_summary: Eager spending when money is available can leave hardship when it runs out.
